name: Vertical Tiki-Taka 4-3-3 DM

slots.why: Sweeper keeper covers the space behind a higher line and is an extra passer.
Support wing-back on the left supplies width and joins the build-up, so this side is more attacking.
Ball-playing defender starts moves with passes into midfield.
Cover centre-back sweeps behind his partner, since the line is higher; Defend is the alternate.
Support full-back on the right stays more conservative, so the team has one more attacking flank and one safer one.
Deep-lying playmaker is the base of the team and distributes it to the runners.
Box-to-box midfielder supports the attack and the press.
Mezzala runs into the half-space to arrive in the box.
Inside forward cuts in from the left to attack the box.
Winger (Support) provides width and links with the midfield.
Lone striker: Advanced Forward runs in behind. Poacher is the alternate.

description: Short combinations are used to progress quickly rather than simply retain possession, with runners attacking spaces created by circulation.
whyGood: The playmaking DM anchors build-up while the eights and front three provide vertical movement and penetration.
whyThisShape: A 4-3-3 that combines short passing with quick, vertical moves: a playmaker sits in front of the defence, a runner and a mezzala move forward from midfield, and the forwards run in behind. It presses at once when the ball is lost.
whenToUse: When you have good passers and quick forwards, against teams that sit in a mid-block and leave space behind their line.
whenNotToUse: Against sides that press well, or when your defenders are not comfortable on the ball or with a high line.

instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Keeps possession in short passes until a forward run opens up.
instructionRationale.Play Out Of Defence: The sweeper keeper and ball-playing defender make building from the back safe.
instructionRationale.Higher Tempo: Moves the ball quickly when the forwards make their runs.
instructionRationale.Pass Into Space: Plays the ball behind the defence for the runners, which is the vertical part.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Presses at once after losing the ball, so possession is regained high.
instructionRationale.Counter: Attacks quickly when the ball is won.
instructionRationale.Higher Line of Engagement: Presses higher up the pitch to keep the play in the opponent's half.
instructionRationale.Higher Defensive Line: Keeps the team compact around the ball; it needs pace in the defence.
